description: Source code for ElectronDispatcher and ElectronApplicationDispatcher classes, managing Electron app interactions within Playwright's server dispatchers.

classes.name: ElectronDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing Electron instances, including launching Electron applications.

classes.name: ElectronApplicationDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing Electron application instances, handling events, browser windows, and expression evaluation.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an Electron application unless launching is denied.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a browser window within the Electron application.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the context of the Electron app.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates event subscriptions for the Electron application.
